title: ee.mesh.origin_event.v1
$comment: DRAFT — pre-implementation artifact for bd-tc-epic-qzk7o.3.1 (T2.0), capturing the bead's pinned design after the 2026-07-30 encoding override + audit override. NOT registered in public_schemas and NOT emitted by any surface yet; the T2.0 implementer owns final field spellings (marked TBD where the bead does not pin them) and registers it alongside the emitter. ee.mesh.event.v1 remains non-origin-authoritative file replay evidence — this stream does not reinterpret it.
description: One immutable outbound origin-stream event: an authenticated generic outer operation carrying exactly one typed payload (ee.mesh.memory_event.v1 or ee.team.manifest_event.v1). Origin-owned local mutations append in the same transaction as the local write; inbound material never re-emits. Every content revision signs blake3 domain-separated over a fresh 32-byte nonce plus the exact body bytes; the nonce is stored atomically with the local event and released only via authorized body fetch — content-identical revisions are unlinkable to metadata-only peers.

eventId.$comment: TBD prefix (implementer): derived from eventHash and excluded from the eventHash preimage, mirroring the ee.mesh.event.v1 idiom.

teamId.description: Random team identity; never derived from names, paths, or hostnames.

originNodeId.description: Random ee node identity (T3.1); never derived from tailnet names, emails, hostnames, IPs, or current keys.

signingKeyGeneration.description: Ed25519 signing-lineage generation at emission time (T3.6 owns lifecycle).

seq.description: Per-origin nondecreasing append position; receivers track receipt and disposition-scan frontiers independently.

prevEventHash.description: Append-only chain link; null only for the valid first event of an origin. Divergent successors of one predecessor are fork evidence.

eventHash.description: blake3 over the canonical event bytes (excluding eventId and signature).

signature.description: Ed25519 over the domain-separated canonical bytes (operator-ratified in v1, bd-tc-epic-qzk7o.9).

payloadSchema.description: Receiver dispatch derives mandatory features and authorization from schema plus operation; requiredFeatures can ADD checks but never remove them.

requiredFeatures.description: Forward-compatibility gates (mesh.* namespace only). Base features are registered but not advertised until T4.1 installs the active-member/node/key authorizer. Unknown mandatory bits structurally quarantine the event (withheld N with applied N+1 and later hydration stays legal).
